decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD costs almost nothing to hold in a warehouse-backed catalog of over 60,000 items, so keeping the option open is cheap even though its sales potential is modest.
The illustrated release series had its own page in both years and fits the firm's curated-edition strategy, so it remains a valuable option for further installments at low carrying cost.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP supports the firm's push into new genres and formats, and stock already pressed costs little to keep listed while demand from collectors becomes clearer.
The multi-disc box set represents a large sunk investment and carries little ongoing cost, so the firm keeps selling it unless the edition sells out.
The compilation CD was only mentioned rather than featured, which signals weaker prospects, but the cost of keeping it in the catalog is minimal, so it is not worth abandoning yet.
